title: FW↔BIZ-001: Firmware Effort Estimates + Feature Timeline for GTM Planning
description: The Firmware Engineer provides firmware development timeline estimates for the business case and GTM (Go-to-Market) planning, OTA (Over-the-Air) update-infrastructure operational-cost inputs, and RTOS (Real-Time Operating System) and third-party-library licensing-cost information; the Business Consultant provides business prioritization of firmware features (e.g., OTA capability prioritized for subscription-model viability), market-driven connectivity requirements (protocol-selection rationale), and RTOS licensing-constraint inputs (open-source vs. commercial RTOS business risk). Grounded in FIRMWARE_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.10. SOURCE NOTE: the edge is asymmetrically documented — BUSINESS_CONSULTANT_SKILL §6 has no Firmware subsection — so fields derive from the Firmware side; reciprocity holds via the shared GTM-planning exchange. No business figures are invented.

firmware_estimates.description: FW→BIZ: development-timeline estimates, OTA operating-cost inputs, licensing costs.

business_priorities.description: BIZ→FW: feature prioritization, connectivity requirements, RTOS licensing constraints.

rationale.description: e.g., OTA prioritized for subscription-model viability.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine firmware effort-estimate / GTM-timeline exchange is agent-autonomous (at product feasibility and GTM planning; on-demand for roadmap prioritization). An estimate that proves infeasible against a committed market window is raised as an ADR, not silently absorbed.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (at product feasibility and GTM planning stages; on-demand for roadmap prioritization)
confirm_conditions: every development-timeline estimate carries a value and an explicit time unit
OTA operating-cost inputs carry value, currency, and unit; licensing costs carry a currency
BIZ feature prioritization is expressed as BIZ-supplied priorities (not firmware-invented)
estimate confidence is disclosed where requested for GTM commitment
reject_conditions: a timeline or cost figure emitted without an explicit unit/currency (units rule §3.10)
a firmware timeline committed to a GTM date known to be infeasible without an ADR flagging the risk (Never Silently Deviate)
a licensing-cost obligation (commercial RTOS/library) omitted from the business case
counter_conditions: an effort estimate requested without the prioritized feature scope — request the BIZ feature ranking before estimating
a market-driven connectivity requirement lacking a protocol rationale — request the selection rationale before sizing firmware effort
